verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies single-company stewardship: the repository lives under the facebook GitHub org, and community threads describe Facebook deciding on its own to relicense React from BSD+Patents to MIT. That signals company control and licensing-related lock-in concerns, but the pack has no first-party statement of who governs React. missing for 10: explicit first-party governance documentation (foundation vs. company ownership), governance model or decision-process details, continuity or succession commitments, independent corroboration of the current governance structure.
